purpose: Install the measured missing computation: semantic decision -> episode-local codebook lookup -> symbol emission, without retraining already-present semantic read/symbol write/carrier binding as the primary objective.

source_evidence_scope.known_measurement_boundary: Model-specific numerical claims only; this synthetic seed grants no training/J-Space/HCU runtime credit.

preregistered_class_word_resolution: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN may appear only inside the explicit CODEBOOK span. CASE and QUERY text must not contain these class tokens. A separately versioned label-free variant may be studied later but is not silently mixed here.

swarm_roles.job: Generate full-S3 episode-local remapping examples across four structurally distinct context families.
Recompute target from realized mapping; reject metadata-only permutations.
Reject target-class tokens outside CODEBOOK and provenance/template split leakage.
Check that case semantics preserve EntityOS/HCU authority and UNKNOWN boundaries.
Check exact class-symbol counterbalance and full S3 coverage.
Keep only rows passing all reviewers; do not promote placeholders to model-feed-ready data.

frozen_holdout_template_policy: A fifth structurally novel template family is reserved and MUST NOT be generated, viewed, or tuned against in this microseed.

audit.reason_not_feed_ready: Exact 46 accepted ABI atom strings/row identities are not present in current canonical repo context; placeholders must be compiled only after manifest-bound atom-table verification.

hard_negative_reviews.description: Permutation metadata says S3_1 but target is derived from the unpermuted mapping.
hard_negative_reviews.reason: Permutation must causally construct class-to-symbol mapping; metadata-only permutation recreates the known critical generator defect.

hard_negative_reviews.description: CASE text literally contains the target class token outside the CODEBOOK span.
hard_negative_reviews.reason: Class labels are allowed only in the preregistered codebook span for this v2 interpretation.

hard_negative_reviews.description: Rows sharing one provenance ancestry are divided across train and frozen holdout.
hard_negative_reviews.reason: Family/provenance ancestry is the split unit; this would leak causal ancestry.

hard_negative_reviews.description: One class-symbol pair occurs more often than another within a template family.
hard_negative_reviews.reason: This microseed requires exact class-symbol counterbalance under full S3 coverage.

hard_negative_reviews.description: The frozen fifth template is used during validation or prompt iteration.
hard_negative_reviews.reason: Frozen unseen-template family must remain absent from train and validation/hyperparameter selection.

external_method_hypothesis.claim: Attention-mediated routing is a plausible mechanism for the missing dynamic binding, but this is not yet a model-specific fact for the target checkpoint.
external_method_hypothesis.support: Recent variable-binding work reports learned attention-mediated routing and residual-stream addressable memory in symbolic programs.
external_method_hypothesis.falsifier: Matched post-training causal tests show equivalent binding without the implicated pathways, or a different module is necessary/sufficient.
